acceptanceCriteria: A numbered requirement, accepted by the owner, defines the ceiling and the platforms.
A test shows the raise is bounded and that failure is non-fatal.
body: Proposed by the V1-1129 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#788, 2026-10-11). EMFILE now maps to retryable RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (CAL-V0-215), but busy macOS hosts keep the default soft limit of 256. A bounded raise toward the hard limit at startup would make exhaustion rarer. This needs its own requirement and owner acceptance; the V1-1129 acceptance does not cover it.
title: Raise the macOS soft RLIMIT_NOFILE at startup within a bounded ceiling
